title: The indigo night kitchen
alt: A sleeping tabby in an indigo kitchen lit by warm copper reflections.
description: A detailed painted interior with a rainy window, warm lamplight and coherent domestic objects.
prompt: A meticulously painted gouache illustration of a cozy kitchen at midnight, indigo tiles, copper pots, a small stove, green plants, a wooden table with a bowl of oranges, rain streaking the dark window and warm pendant lights. A sleepy striped cat curls naturally on a chair. Rich hand-painted texture, intricate believable domestic details, controlled amber-and-blue light, no readable writing.
